name: exampass
title_zh: 期末复习把整门课压成三张纸的讲义生成器
tagline_zh: PPT、Word、PDF、截图混着丢进去，按章节吐出知识清单、教授式讲解和自测题。不用自己划重点。
tagline_en: Feed it slides, docs, PDFs, photos—get chapter-wise cheat sheets, professor-style explanations, and quizzes. No.
desc_en: 将课程资料（PPT/Word/PDF/截图）按章节生成深度知识清单、教授式详细讲解和交互式章节测试，帮助学生高效期末复习。
why_zh: 不是摘要工具，是教学引擎：先按章节拆解知识密度，再决定讲多深、考什么。讲解口吻像教授划重点。
why_en: Not a summarizer—a teaching engine. It maps knowledge density per chapter, then decides depth and quiz focus. Explains like a.
limit_zh: 只吃课程资料，不接教材以外的杂文档；输出是复习讲义和测试题，不含记忆曲线排期；图片需文字清晰，手写潦草会识别错。
limit_en: Only course materials, no random docs. Output is notes & quizzes—no spaced-repetition scheduling. Blurry or messy handwriting in images will misread.
title_en: Compress a course into three exam-ready sheets
